newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX breaks 200 point level in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX breaks 200 point level in thin trading.

text.p: The Slovak SAX index broke through the 200-point barrier, closing up 2.69 points to 201.93, on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Wednesday.
However, brokers were quick to point out that volumes were still below a level that they considered satisfactory.
"The promising development of the SAX index is not prompting an adequate response from the market at present," Peter Lachkovic of Slovenska Sporitelna said.
"The numbers may be changing, but often due to one or two share deals," he said.
Drug producer Slovakofarma boosted the index with a 259 crowns rise to 4,874 but traded only three shares.
"Slovakofarma has a long-standing problem with liquidity, as most individual shareholders have already sold their shares," Lachkovic said.
Steel maker VSZ closed down two at 695 crowns, with 10,868 shares traded mainly in blocks.
Oil refinery Slovnaft closed unchanged at 900 crowns, on volume of 149 shares.
Overall volume eased to 620,979 shares, from 1.04 million shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover decreased to 733.86 million crowns, from 1.14 billion.
